name: Sofia Ramirez Garcia
bio:
Sofia Ramirez Garcia's career in motorsport security began unexpectedly after a stint in the Mexican Federal Police, where her sharp eye for detail and meticulous approach quickly set her apart. Drawn to the high-stakes environment of racing, she transitioned into motorsport security, initially managing logistics for smaller racing teams before being headhunted by Mercedes-AMG. 

Sofia is known for her relentless commitment to safety protocols and proactive risk assessment. She believes in staying one step ahead of potential threats, implementing rigorous security measures that prioritize both personnel and assets. Her demanding nature stems from a deep-seated desire to ensure the well-being of everyone involved, earning her respect, albeit sometimes grudgingly, from her team. What makes Sofia stand out is her unexpected creativity in devising security solutions, often thinking outside the box to address complex challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly braided and pulled back into a tight bun
physical.description: A stern woman with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Carries a small, well-worn copy of the FIA security regulations at all times.
Insists on personally inspecting every security checkpoint before each race.
Has a habit of speaking in acronyms and codes, even in casual conversation.
